Definition: neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb μάλα (very); (adverbially) most (in the greatest degree) or particularly:--chiefly, most of all, (e-)specially.
BiblicalUsage: Malista means especially, chiefly, most of all, and it is Paul's word for where the duty lands first. Galatians 6:10 says do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith, and 1 Timothy 5:8 says a man must provide for his own, and specially for those of his own house, while 1 Timothy 4:10 calls God the Saviour of all men, specially of those that believe.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the especially here is the shape of Christian love: for all, and first for the household of faith.
